mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for June 19, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. Some UN Security Council members warn Gaza humanitarian crisis worsening despite ceasefire.. Pakistan, China, UK and Russia call for unrestricted aid access as US blames Hamas for ongoing suffering in enclave. This was reported by Anadolu Agency. 2. Paper shortages pushes Gaza's students to write on aid boxes.. Israel has destroyed more than 284 schools and 63 university buildings across Gaza, disrupting access to education and hindering students' studies. This was reported by The New Arab. 3. Israeli occupiers seize Palestinian vehicle, block entrances in West Bank town.. Occupiers raid Deir Dibwan hours after Israeli army, police forces deployed in area. This was reported by Anadolu Agency. 4. US-Iran talks in Switzerland delayed, Israel strikes Lebanon.. US Vice President JD Vance delayed a planned trip to Switzerland to lead a new round of talks with Iran, as. Israel continues attacking Gaza and Lebanon. This was reported by The New Arab. 5. Gaza.
